places.name: Patagonia
places.locationDefinition: Existing approved Patagonia representative point and outline.

places.name: Torres del Paine
places.locationDefinition: Torres del Paine National Park only, as confirmed by the owner. Select the SNASPE protected-area polygon containing the Paine core. Includes the Torres and Lago Grey park sectors; excludes Puerto Natales and the much larger Torres del Paine municipality. Publisher stripped feature names; identify the unique park polygon by fixed source checksum, known landmarks and its extent.

places.name: Fuji
places.locationDefinition: Mount Fuji and all Fuji Five Lakes. Use the connected Fuji mainland sector of the Ministry of Environment Fuji-Hakone-Izu park zoning geometry. Fill interior settlement/water holes to represent the complete geographic region, including Motosu, Shoji, Saiko, Kawaguchi and Yamanaka lakes. Excludes the disconnected Hakone, Izu Peninsula and Izu island sectors. This is a sourced regional display footprint, not a claim that filled interior areas have national-park protection.

places.name: Izu
places.locationDefinition: Izu Peninsula regional footprint: dissolve the 15 peninsula municipalities Numazu, Atami, Mishima, Ito, Shimoda, Izu, Izunokuni, Higashiizu, Kawazu, Minamiizu, Matsuzaki, Nishiizu, Kannami, Shimizu and Nagaizumi. Retains their coastal shape and larger coastal islands; omits display islets smaller than 0.01 km2. Excludes the distant Izu Islands, Mount Fuji and Hakone. Municipalities define an administrative approximation of the peninsula region, not a surveyed natural boundary. The published municipal GeoJSON flattened detached coastal parts into polygon ring lists; rebuild those rings as parts before dissolving and filling regional interior holes, so the mainlands of Numazu, Shimoda and Minamiizu are retained.

places.name: Lake Atitlan
places.locationDefinition: Lago de Atitlan waterbody shoreline only, as confirmed by the owner. Published LAGO01 polygon (source area 123.508 km2), converted from Guatemala Transverse Mercator ESRI:103598 to WGS84 using the projection definition published with the source viewer. Excludes the surrounding watershed, towns and volcanoes. Shoreline reflects the source observation rather than a claim of a live water level.

places.name: Bali
places.locationDefinition: Bali province, including its associated coastal islands.

places.name: Algarve
places.locationDefinition: Faro district, corresponding to the Algarve region.

places.name: Santorini
places.locationDefinition: Santorini island group: complete Greek coastline components within 25.25–25.55°E, 36.3–36.5°N. The caldera water is excluded.

places.name: Komodo
places.locationDefinition: Komodo island only: the complete Indonesian coastline component containing the representative point. Excludes Rinca, Padar and the wider national park.

places.name: Cappadocia
places.locationDefinition: Approximate broad Cappadocia scope from the owner's screenshot: dissolved union of Nevşehir (TR-50), Aksaray (TR-68), Niğde (TR-51) and Kayseri (TR-38). Generalized province-based geographic interpretation, not an official historical-region boundary or an exact copy of Google's outline.

places.name: Atacama
places.locationDefinition: San Pedro de Atacama desert destination region, as confirmed by the owner. Use the San Pedro de Atacama commune boundary as a sourced regional display approximation, covering the town, surrounding desert, salt-flat and high-altitude destinations. Excludes the broad Atacama Desert, Atacama administrative region, Calama and the coast. This is an administrative footprint for the San Pedro area, not a natural desert boundary.
